title: SkillRep: Characterizing and Understanding the Representation Design Space of Agent Skill Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.32336v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieving the right skill from a large library is essential for LLM agents, yet requests and skills are written for different purposes and in different words. Existing retrievers narrow this request-skill gap with one or two representation choices each, so it is unknown whether their gains hold in combination. No prior work measures the gap itself, so it is also unclear which part of it each choice narrows. We define a representation design space by five choices -- encoder fine-tuning, query-side and document-side expansion, background projection and a lexical channel -- and evaluate them together for the first time, as modules of one retriever, SkillRep. With a 0.6B encoder and LLM expansion, SkillRep improves MRR@10 on SRA-Bench over the strongest same-size retriever by 7.02 points with the official skill pool and 8.79 with UniPool, a 111,247-skill pool we build from public registries, and is best on SkillsBench. translated_title: SkillRep：刻画与理解智能体技能检索的表示设计空间
translated_abstract: 从庞大的技能库中检索出正确的技能对 LLM 智能体至关重要，然而请求与技能的撰写目的和用词各不相同。现有的检索器各自仅通过一到两种表示选择来缩小这种“请求-技能”差距，因此尚不清楚这些方法结合使用时其收益是否依然成立。此前没有工作测量这一差距本身，因此也不清楚每种选择分别缩小了差距的哪一部分。我们通过五种选择——编码器微调、查询侧与文档侧扩展、背景投影以及词法通道——定义了一个表示设计空间，并首次将它们作为一个统一检索器 SkillRep 的模块进行联合评估。借助 0.6B 规模的编码器和 LLM 扩展，SkillRep 在 SRA-Bench 上使用官方技能池时，MRR@10 相比最强的同规模检索器提升了 7.02 分；使用我们基于公共注册库构建的、包含 111,247 个技能的 UniPool 时提升了 8.79 分，并在 SkillsBench 上取得最佳表现。每种选择的价值……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次将五种表示选择（编码器微调、查询侧与文档侧扩展、背景投影和词法通道）作为统一检索器 SkillRep 的模块进行联合评估，系统刻画了智能体技能检索的表示设计空间，并在多个基准上取得最优性能。
en_tdlr: This paper presents SkillRep, the first retriever to jointly evaluate five representation choices—encoder fine-tuning, query-side and document-side expansion, background projection, and a lexical channel—characterizing the representation design space of agent skill retrieval and achieving state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks.
